name: Gym-PushT simulation
description: Write a Python class Policy whose act(observation) returns the pushing disc's target position in gym-pusht's PushT-v0 from the state vector (agent position, T-block position and angle); scored by the fraction of 100 fixed episodes (reset seeds 0-99, at most 300 steps each) in which the block covers more than 95% of the goal region (higher is better).

sources.locator: gym_pusht/envs/pusht.py: PushT-v0 state observation, PD-controlled agent, coverage-based success (success_threshold 0.95); gym_pusht/__init__.py: max_episode_steps 300
